global: This shio ramen features a clear, savory broth with halved soft-boiled eggs and menma bamboo shoots arranged atop noodles. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, oval-shaped surface.
regions.bowl: Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate wave pattern and scalloped rim, glossy finish.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, light golden, and gently swirling around noodles and toppings.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a smooth, creamy orange yolk and firm white, with a glossy surface and rounded shape.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curled shapes.
